articles.title_zh: NeuroSymbEAD:用于Omni-Directional自動駕駛的大型的神经-自旋控制带数据集
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍了神经系统(NeuroSymbEAD),这是一个大型的神经-同位素标题数据集,其特点是以自我为中心的静态和动态物体知识图(KG),并附有分类、类别、方向、方向和与自我车辆的距离。 这些说明在KITTI-360数据集中被使用来生成多层文字标题,代表一个以自我为中心的场景地图的轻量级版本. 户外场景图重建,视觉识别,以及物体搁浅,为驱动常识和交通/场景理解确定了基线. 为此,基于自然语言的基于物体的字幕及其复杂关系是广泛采用的室内场景任务的背景说明。 事实证明,神经符号表示法在处理各种计算机视觉和语言应用的结构化信息方面是有效的。 我们的数据注释管道允许生成不同的地图段,在任何3D对象检测网络预测的边框内充填模拟或真实的物体,并构建分级的文字标题。 我们使用训练有素的地面定位和学习到的自动递归式字幕网络,来计算我们的神经同位素和本体学字幕生成。 通过将3D驱动场景转换为结构化的自我中心语言,NeurosSymbEAD为视觉语言和交通场景解释的基础模型,3D推理,以及可解释的自主驾驶感知提供了基准.

articles.title: PiPS: Post-Hoc Prototypical Explanations for Interpretable Semantic Segmentation
articles.content: With the increasing deployment of deep neural networks in critical systems, such as medical diagnostics and autonomous vehicles, ensuring their interpretability is crucial to building trust in decision-making systems. In the field of explainable artificial intelligence, prototype-based reasoning has gained particular popularity, as it mimics human cognitive processes by explaining model decisions based on visual similarity under the looks like this paradigm. While this paradigm has been thoroughly investigated in the context of global image classification, the interpretability of dense predictions, particularly semantic segmentation, remains largely unexplored despite its immense importance in tasks requiring precise object localization. Existing prototype-based interpretable segmentation models rely on ante-hoc architectures, which entails significant limitations because they require costly training from scratch and modifications to the network structure, ultimately leading to a noticeable drop in predictive performance compared to standard black-box models. To address this issue, we propose PiPS (Post-hoc interpretable Prototypical Segmentation), the first fully post-hoc solution for generating prototypical explanations for semantic segmentation models. Our method enables the extraction of intuitive, spatially localized explanations from any pre-trained network without modification or fine-tuning, thereby preserving 100% of the model's original predictive performance. This approach opens a new avenue for the safe and cost-effective deployment of transparent systems in advanced computer vision tasks. Codebase available at https://github.com/gmum/PIPS.

articles.title_zh: PipS:可解释语义分裂的后热原型解释
articles.content_zh: 随着医疗诊断和自主载体等关键系统中深度神经网络的日益部署,确保其可解释性对于建立对决策系统的信任至关重要。 在可解释的人工智能领域,基于原型的推理特别受欢迎,因为它通过在类似这种范式的外观下解释基于视觉相似性的模型决定来模仿人类的认知过程. 虽然在全球图像分类的背景下对这一范式进行了彻底调查,但密集预测的可解释性,特别是语义分解,尽管在需要精确对象定位的任务中具有巨大重要性,但基本上仍未加以探讨。 现有的基于原型的可解释分解模型依赖于前热结构,这需要很大的限制,因为它们需要从零开始昂贵的培训和对网络结构的修改,最终导致预测性能与标准黑箱模型相比明显下降. 为了解决这一问题,我们提出PipS(Post-hoc可解释的原位分解),这是第一个完全后位分解为语义分解模型生成原位分解解释的原位分解解决方案. 我们的方法能够从任何预先训练的网络中提取直观的,空间化的解释,而无需修改或微调,从而保留了模型最初的预测性能的100%. 这种做法为在先进的计算机远景任务中安全、有成本效益地部署透明系统开辟了新的途径。 可在https://github.com/gmum/PIPS上查阅代码库.

articles.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
articles.content: We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution evidence into tasks and evaluation rubrics for continual learning. At its core is recursive-in-recursive self-improvement, a paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning: the inner recursion improves the harness with the model fixed, while the outer recursion trains the model under the improved harness. Harness evolution shapes training experience, and model learning creates new opportunities for harness adaptation. We present case studies of researcher interaction, harness refinement, and model learning, with the benchmark cases spanning four scientific task families. By releasing ScienceBuddy as a research product, we make this paradigm available to the scientific community and take a step toward discovery intelligence: scientific AI that advances through sustained collaboration with researchers and evolves alongside the research it supports. Website: http://science-buddy.io

articles.title_zh: ScienceBuddy:互动科学代理的递归自我提升
articles.content_zh: 我们引入并发布了ScienceBuddy, 一个互动的科学研究工作空间, 不断改进科研代理 进入研究人员的日常工作流程。 ScienceBuddy支持研究人员执行科学任务,同时将其请求、反馈和执行证据转化为持续学习的任务和评价主题。 其核心是递归性-递归性自我改进,这是情侣利用模型强化学习来利用进化的范式:内递归性用模型固定来改进带子,外递归性则在改进的带子下训练模型. 利用演变塑造了培训经验,模型学习为利用适应创造了新的机会。 我们介绍了研究人员互动、利用改进和模式学习的案例研究,基准案例涵盖四个科学任务领域。 通过释放ScienceBuddy作为研究产品,我们向科学界提供这个范式,并朝着发现智能迈出一步:通过与研究人员的持续合作而进步的科学AI,与它所支持的研究同时发展。 网址:http://science-buddy.io

articles.title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control
articles.content: Large language models can produce fluent answers when their factual support is weak. This paper introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework that makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of the information required to answer a question. We evaluate three CoSQ variants under seventeen conditions on the 817-item TruthfulQA multiple-choice validation set using eleven open-weight and hosted model families. In the final balanced-option protocol, Grounded-CoSQ at τ=0.90 reduces the mean unconditional wrong-commitment rate from 13.1% under chain-of-thought prompting to 8.9%, a 32.1% relative reduction, while increasing answered accuracy from 86.9% to 89.7% and answering 87.6% of questions. Both improvements hold for all eleven models and at every evaluated threshold. Critical-CoSQ and Adaptive-CoSQ provide neighboring operating points with 88.6% and 86.5% coverage, respectively, while remaining more reliable than the baseline. A secondary Natural Questions Short-Answer evaluation provides convergent open-form evidence. These findings show that self-assessment can support explicit, tunable answer-or-abstain decisions when an unsupported commitment is more costly than referral or review.

articles.title_zh: LLMs应该什么时候放弃? 选择性风险控制自问链
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型在事实支持薄弱时可以产生流利的答案. 本文件介绍了 " 自我提问链 " (CoSQ),这是一个以明确评估回答问题所需信息为条件的迅速框架。 我们在17个条件下评估了三个CoSQ的变体 817项 TruthfulQA 多选择验证集 使用11个开放重量和托管模式家庭。 在最终的平衡选择协议中,Grounded-CoSQ = 0.90 将平均无条件错误承诺率从思维链下的13.1%降低到8.9%,相对降低32.1%,同时将回答准确度从86.9%提高到89.7%,回答87.6%的问题. 所有11种模型和每个评估阈值都有改进。 Critical-CoSQ和Adaptive-CoSQ分别为邻近的操作点提供88.6%和86.5%的覆盖范围,同时保持比基线更可靠. 二次自然问题短答评价提供了趋同的开放式证据. 这些调查结果表明,当无支持的承诺比转介或审查费用更高时,自我评估可以支持作出明确、可捕性强的回答或吸收决定。

articles.title: What Breaks Under Pruning in Smart Homes, and When? Evaluating LLM Degradation Across Architectures and Task Complexity
articles.content: Pruning can reduce the deployment cost of large language models (LLMs), but its impact on context-grounded tool calling remains poorly understood. We systematically study pruning-induced degradation in smart-home tool calling across four LLMs spanning dense Transformer, dense hybrid, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, together with depth, width, hybrid, and expert pruning methods. After post-pruning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we evaluate more than 19,500 instances from three smart-home datasets. Beyond aggregate task accuracy, we characterize degradation along two dimensions: action components (i.e., operation, device, argument, and value) and task complexity. Our results show that dense models have narrow safe pruning regions followed by sharp degradation, while MoE models tolerate substantially more pruning. Pruning degrades grounded specificity before schema-level intent, and aggressive dense pruning can induce systematic over-refusal. These findings highlight the importance of evaluating pruning beyond aggregate accuracy when selecting pruned LLMs for reliable tool execution.

articles.title_zh: 在聪明的家里有什么突破和什么时候? 跨结构和任务复杂度的LLM退化评估
articles.content_zh: Pruning可以降低大型语言模型(LLMs)的部署成本,但它对基于背景的工具调用的影响仍然不甚了解. 我们系统地研究智能家庭工具中由螺旋引起的退化,这些工具涉及跨越密集变形器、密集混合体和专家混合体(MoE)结构的四个LLM,以及深度、宽度、混合体和专家挤压方法。 经过后推式监督微调(SFT)后,我们从三个智能家庭数据集评价了超过19,500个实例. 除了总体任务准确性外,我们还从两个方面来描述退化:行动组成部分(即操作、装置、论据和价值)和任务复杂性。 我们的结果显示,密集模型具有狭窄的安全灌丛区域,然后是急剧退化,而教育部模型则容忍更多的灌丛。 挤压在计划一级意图之前会降低根基特异性,进攻性的密集挤压可引起系统性的过度反驳. 这些调查结果突出表明,在选择用于可靠工具执行的经压缩的LLMs时,评价超出总体准确性的重要性。

articles.title: LACE: Layer-Wise Compression for Dynamic Frame Rate Codecs
articles.content: Neural audio codecs are a key component in speech language modeling. However, their high frame rates lead to long sequence lengths, increasing computational costs. Dynamic frame rate codecs mitigate this by reducing the effective frame rate using a compression step to merge multiple frames together. However, most prior methods either operate on single-codebook codecs or apply a single compression step before multi-layer quantization. This forces all quantization layers to share the same segmentation boundaries, despite the residual embeddings at different quantization layers exhibiting different rates of change over time. We propose LACE (Layer-Adaptive Codec Encoding), a dynamic frame rate codec that applies an independent compression step at each quantization layer, enabling layer-specific segmentation boundaries. To use LACE tokens in downstream text-to-speech (TTS), we further introduce union alignment and boundary anchor mechanisms to make durations consistent across layers while preserving compression benefits. Experiments on LibriTTS show that LACE offers a better rate-quality tradeoff than prior dynamic frame rate methods on the reconstruction task and improves TTS inference efficiency while maintaining competitive synthesis quality. Our code is released as part of the ESPnet3 codec recipe.

articles.title_zh: LACE: 动态框架速率压缩图层
articles.content_zh: 神经音频编解码器是语音语言建模的关键组成部分. 然而,其高帧率导致长序长度,增加了计算成本. 动态帧速率编码器通过使用压缩步骤将多个帧合并在一起来降低有效帧速率来缓解这一点. 然而,大多数前期方法要么在单码本编码器上操作,要么在多层分解前应用单一压缩步骤. 这迫使所有的量子化层都共享相同的分界线,尽管不同量子化层的剩余嵌入会显示不同时间的变化速度. 我们提出LACE(Layer-Adaptive Codec Encoding),即一个动态帧速率编码器,在每个整数层上应用一个独立的压缩步骤,能够实现层特异分解边界. 为了在下游的文本对语音(TTS)中使用LACE符号,我们进一步引入了联盟对齐和边界锚定机制,使持续时间在各层之间保持一致,同时保持压缩效益. 在LibriTTS上的实验表明,LACE在重建任务上比之前的动态帧率方法提供更好的速率质量权衡,并在保持竞争性合成质量的同时提高TTS推论效率. 我们的代码作为ESPnet3代码配方的一部分发布.

articles.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants
articles.content: LLM assistants are widely used for daily social advice, yet evaluating their social reasoning in such consultation settings remains challenging since (i) it requires setups where the assistant learns about social situations from subjective user narratives, and (ii) social properties, such as others' intentions, typically lack verifiable ground truth. To address these challenges, we introduce Fuse, a multi-agent simulation framework for studying user-mediated social reasoning. In Fuse, a target agent with a hidden motive interacts with other agents including one representing the user, who then consults the evaluated assistant to infer the target's motive, providing verifiable ground truth by construction. Simulation faithfulness is validated through a human study with 24k annotations. We apply Fuse to 12 LLMs and demonstrate its analytical utility by systematically isolating key factors, showing that (i) user mediation compounds the inherent difficulty of social reasoning; (ii) LLMs exhibit systematic sensitivity to biased user framing; (iii) models can require more details than humans need to reach a correct prediction; and (iv) longer conversations do not always improve performance despite providing opportunities for clarifying questions. We open-source Fuse and a dataset with 21k examples.

articles.title_zh: LLM助理的可核实社会理由
articles.content_zh: LLM助手被广泛用于日常的社会咨询,然而在这样的咨询环境中评价他们的社会推理仍然具有挑战性,因为(一)它需要设置这样的结构,即助理从主观的用户叙事中学习社会状况,(二)社会属性,如他人的意图,通常缺乏可核实的基础真相. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了Fuse,一个研究用户引导的社会推理的多代理模拟框架. 在Fuse中,一个具有隐藏动机的目标特工与其他特工包括一名代表用户的特工进行互动,后者随后会咨询被评价的助手推断目标动机,通过构建提供可核实的地面真相. 模拟忠诚通过人类研究验证,并附有24k的说明. 我们把Fuse应用于12个LLM,并通过系统地隔离关键因素来展示其分析效用,表明(一) 用户调解增加了社会推理的内在难度;(二) LLM对有偏见的用户框架表现出系统敏感性;(三) 模型可能比人类需要更多的细节来达成正确的预测;(四) 尽管提供了澄清问题的机会,较长的对话并不总是能提高性能. 我们开源Fuse 和一个有21k例的数据集.

articles.title: Right Tool, Right Job: Native-Language Evaluation, Tokenizer Sensitivity, and Methodological Findings from a French-Only BabyLM
articles.content: We submit MéTRON-FR, a 125M GPT-2 pretrained on 92.47M words of French, to the BabyLM 2026 Strict track. It scores 85.97 +/- 0.17% on QFrBLiMP (a native Quebec-French benchmark of grammatical minimal pairs) and 62.80% on the BabyLM-weighted leaderboard. A cross-lingual GLUE (General Language Understanding Evaluation) protocol that combines French task-data translation with rank-16 LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) produces a sharp task-type gradient: relational tasks gain measurably, while world-knowledge tasks regress. Bilingual Lexicon Induction aligns the French embeddings to GPT-2 at p@1 = 68.84 +/- 8.61%, 18X above chance, suggesting cross-lingual alignment tracks acquired grammatical competence rather than training duration. An ablation study shows that single-token zero-shot scoring is dominated by tokenizer and template artifacts at the child scale, motivating tokenizer-swap sensitivity, placebo-controlled prompting, and native-language minimal-pair benchmarks as standard diagnostics.

articles.title: CareMirror: Bringing Caregiver Wellbeing into the Dementia Care Ecosystem
articles.content: Family caregivers of people living with dementia shoulder emotional and practical responsibilities, yet their own wellbeing often remains peripheral to dementia care. We built CareMirror, an envisioned caregiver wellbeing ecosystem with interconnected caregiver- and clinician-facing interfaces for longitudinal reflection, personalized support, and caregiver-controlled sharing with clinical care. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 14 caregivers, using CareMirror as a design probe to examine how they perceived this ecosystem and what expectations, concerns, and boundaries emerged around clinical connection. Caregivers valued attention to their wellbeing, longitudinal awareness, context-sensitive support, and clinical visibility when it could lead to meaningful follow-up. However, repeated reflection could become burdensome or emotionally difficult, automatic clinical sharing could inhibit candid disclosure, and participants wanted control over what information entered clinical care. They also expected AI to support reflection and communication without replacing caregiver voice or clinician judgment. We contribute design considerations for proactive, clinically connected caregiver wellbeing support.

articles.content_zh: 痴呆症患者的家庭照顾者承担着情感和实际责任,然而,他们自身的福利往往仍然是痴呆症护理的边缘。 我们建造了CareMiror,这是一个设想中的护理者福祉生态系统,它具有互联互通的护理者和临床医生界面,用于纵向反思、个性化支助以及护理者与临床护理的共享。 我们与14名护理人员进行了半结构化的访谈, 利用CareMirror作为设计探针, 来研究他们如何看待这个生态系统, 以及围绕临床联系出现的期望、关注和界限。 护理者重视关注他们的福祉、纵向认识、对背景有敏感认识的支助以及临床可见度,因为这样做可以带来有意义的后续行动。 然而,反复反思可能会变得负担沉重或感情上困难,自动的临床共享会抑制坦率的披露,参与者希望控制哪些信息进入临床护理. 他们还期望大赦国际支持思考和沟通,而不取代护理者的声音或临床医生的判断。 我们为主动、与临床有关的护理者福利支助提供设计考虑。

articles.title: Enhancing Accessibility of Medical Texts through Large Language Model-Driven Plain Language Adaptation
articles.content: This paper addresses the challenge of making complex healthcare information more accessible through automated Plain Language Adaptation (PLA). PLA aims to simplify technical medical language, bridging a critical gap between the complexity of healthcare texts and patients' reading comprehension. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs), such as GPT and BART, have opened new possibilities for PLA, especially in zero-shot and few-shot learning contexts where task-specific data is limited. In this work, we leverage the capabilities of LLMs such as GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-1.5-pro, and LLaMA for text simplification. Additionally, we incorporate Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) techniques to enhance adaptability and robustness in PLA tasks. Key contributions include a comparative analysis of prompting strategies, finetuning with QLoRA on different LLMs, and the integration of MoA technique. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of LLM-driven PLA, showcasing its potential in making healthcare information more comprehensible while preserving essential content.

articles.title: Large Language Models Develop Belief State Geometry In-Context
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) trained on next-token prediction exhibit remarkable in-context learning (ICL) abilities, yet the representations that support ICL remain poorly understood. We consider such representations in a controlled setting: prompting LLMs with data emitted from hidden Markov models (HMMs) and probing for the corresponding belief state -- the posterior distribution over the HMM's hidden states given the observed token history. Across six open-source LLMs prompted with data from 40 HMMs selected for non-trivial belief structure, we find that belief states are linearly decodable from residual stream activations, with peak probe $R^2$-values from 0.83-0.99 across HMM and LLM combinations, ranging from early to late layers. To establish functional relevance, we intervene directly on the probe-identified subspace via patching and steering, resulting in downstream prediction quality on the order of the untampered model, while controls degrade performance substantially. Together, these results provide representation-level evidence that ICL in open-source LLMs approximates optimal Bayesian prediction over a context-inferred generative model. More broadly, our findings extend prior results linking input-distribution structure to activation geometry: from toy networks trained explicitly on HMM data to production-scale LLMs.

articles.title_zh: 大语言模型 开发信仰状态几何内文
articles.content_zh: 接受过邻接预测培训的大型语言模型显示出显著的内语学习能力,但支持ICL的表述仍然不为人所知。 我们认为,这种表述是在一个可控制的环境中进行的:用隐藏的Markov模型(HMMM)所排放的数据提示LLMs,并探测相应的信仰状态 -- -- 鉴于观察到的象征历史,HMM隐藏状态的后期分布。 通过从40个HMM中选取的非三角信仰结构的数据,我们发现,在6个开源LLMs中,信仰状态可以线性地从残余流激活中解开,峰值探测器$R^2美元-值从0.83-0.99到HMM和LLM组合,从早期到晚期层不等。 为了确定功能相关性,我们通过补丁和制导直接干预探测器识别的子空间,从而按照无补丁模型的顺序产生下游预测质量,同时控制大量降解性能. 这些结果共同提供了表现层面的证据,表明开源LLMs中的ICL与上下文推导的基因模型的贝叶斯最佳预测相近. 更广泛地说,我们的调查结果将以前将输入-分配结构联系起来的结果扩大到激活几何:从明确接受HMM数据培训的玩具网络到生产规模的LLMs。

articles.title: ECHO: A Matched-Contrast Benchmark for Context-Sensitive Turn-Taking in Full-Duplex Dialogue
articles.content: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems must distinguish interruptions that require yielding the floor from backchannels that permit continued speaking. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate events independently and may therefore reward fixed action preferences rather than context-sensitive decisions. We introduce ECHO, a paired diagnostic benchmark for Chinese full-duplex turn-taking. ECHO pairs examples with the same overlap transcript but contrasting preceding multi-turn dialogue contexts, with one requiring Yield and the other Keep. It additionally includes off-talk examples for diagnosing unnecessary yielding. We introduce pair accuracy, which requires correct decisions on both members of a pair and assigns no credit to constant-action policies. Experiments on multiple full-duplex systems show that most exhibit a pronounced bias toward \textsc{Yield}, performing substantially better on interruptions than on backchannels, while another system remains comparatively balanced. These findings demonstrate that interruption-only evaluation can overestimate practical turn-taking reliability. ECHO and its metadata will be publicly released.

articles.title_zh: 欧共体人道处:在全面双层对话中进行环境敏感性转换的匹配和一致基准
articles.content_zh: 完全繁复的口语对话系统必须区分需要发言的中断和允许继续发言的后通道。 现有基准通常独立评估事件,因此可能奖励固定的行动偏好,而不是注重具体情况的决定。 我们引入了ECHO,一个双双诊断基准,用于中国的全双转向. 欧共体人道处将相同重叠记录抄袭的例子配对,但对比了之前多回合对话的背景,其中一个需要Yield和另一个Keep。 它还包括诊断不必要的结果的闲谈例子。 我们引入配对准确性,这需要对两个配对成员作出正确的决定,并且不给经常行动政策任何功劳。 对多个全复式系统的实验表明,大多数系统表现出对\textsc{Yield}的明显偏差,在中断时的表现大大优于在后通道,而另一个系统则保持相对平衡. 这些调查结果表明,只进行中断性评价可以高估实际操作的可靠性。 欧共体人道处及其元数据将公开发布。

articles.title: Where Should a Document Live: Context, Representations, or Parameters?
articles.content: To answer questions outside of their pre-training data, large language models (LLMs) need access to new information, which can be presented in the context window as documents, encoded into the model's parameters, or injected as latent representations. However, each of these methods comes with different efficiency, cost, and performance trade-offs, with no single winner. We present a controlled comparison of representation-based (KV-cache based) and parametric (fine-tuning-based) adaptation methods on five knowledge-intensive benchmarks. We show that in the oracle setting, Cartridges (KV) are the most accurate injection method at nearly every storage budget, outperforming parametric methods by 10 points. Compaction (KV) matches Cartridges only at low compression rates, lagging behind the parametric methods by 10 points at rates higher than $50\times$. In the more realistic multi-document retrieval scenario, Cartridges are the only method that matches in-context learning (ICL), leading the parametric methods by 29 points and Compaction by 15 points. Nonetheless, Cartridges are also the only method, besides full fine-tuning and large MLP adapters, that suffers from catastrophic forgetting, i.e., a 6% performance degradation on control benchmarks, with 13% in coding.

articles.title_zh: 文件应该放在哪里:背景、表现或参数?
articles.content_zh: 为了在训练前数据之外回答问题,大型语言模型(LLMs)需要访问新信息,这些信息可以作为文档在上下文窗口中呈现,编码到模型的参数中,或者作为潜在表达方式注入. 然而,这些方法中的每一种都以不同的效率,成本和性能的权衡而来,没有单一的胜者. 我们根据五个知识密集型基准,对基于代表性(KV-cache)和参数化(精细调整)的适应方法进行了有控制的比较。 我们显示,在甲骨文设定中,Cartridges(KV)是几乎每个存储预算最精确的注射方法,比性能的参数法高出10点. Concession(KV)只在低压缩速率下与Cartridges匹配,落后于参数法10点,速度高于50\times$. 在更现实的多文件检索方案下,Cartridges是唯一匹配context学习(ICL)的方法,领先参数法29分,压缩15分. 尽管如此,除了完全微调和大型的MLP适配器外,Cartridge也是造成灾难性遗忘的唯一方法,即控制基准的性能退化6%,编码率为13%。

articles.title: Vroom-Vroom at SHROOM-Visions: A Multi-Judge Committee for Detecting Hallucinated Spans in Vision-Language Outputs
articles.content: This paper describes our submission to the SHROOM-Visions shared task on detecting and classifying hallucinated character spans in vision-language model outputs across four languages. We employ several fine-tuned vision-language models as independent annotators and combine their span predictions through character-level majority voting, and additionally explore activation probes. The approach ranks first in three of four languages and places on the podium in every language and metric. Our analysis indicates that disagreement among diverse models tracks disagreement among human annotators.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SHROOM-Visions的Vroom-Vroom:在Vision-Language中检测幻觉的多位法官委员会
articles.content_zh: 本文件介绍了我们向SHROOM-Visions共同承担的任务,即用四种语言的视觉语言模型产出来检测和分类幻觉特征。 我们使用若干微调的视觉语言模型作为独立的注释器,并通过性格级多数投票来结合其跨度预测,并另外探索激活探测器. 这种方法在四种语言中排在第三位,在主席台上摆放每种语言和指标。 我们的分析表明,不同模式之间的分歧是人类注释者之间的分歧。

articles.title: Towards Detecting AI-Assisted Responses in Online Surveys
articles.content: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains underexplored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired with genuine human responses. Our evaluation of existing machine-generated text (MGT) detectors shows that naive AI usage is readily detectable, whereas persona-grounded agents that mimic entire respondents push detector performance toward chance. We further show that agentic completion cannot fully replicate respondent-level behaviour and leaves distinctive behavioural traces. While individual cues can be circumvented by targeted prompting, a simple few-shot, training-free aggregator over these cues improves mean AUROC by +0.14 over the best existing detector across agentic settings. Our project is available at https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURRE.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在在线调查中发现AI-Asssociated的回复
articles.content_zh: 使用有限责任公司完成在线调查会影响基于调查的研究的有效性,但检测这种使用仍然不够。 我们采用了一个初步基准数据集,即ASURRE,用于AI协助调查的参与,以掌握从全生成和修订到人基物剂完成等各种使用战略。 受这些战略的控制,利用不同学科的三项现实世界调查的多种LLM,结合真正的人类反应生成LLM辅助调查响应. 我们对现有机器生成的文本(MGT)探测器的评价显示,天真AI的使用是很容易察觉的,而模仿整个被调查者的人造物剂则将探测器的性能推向机会。 我们进一步表明,代理完成不能完全复制被告一级的行为,留下明显的行为痕迹。 虽然个别提示可以通过定向提示来规避,但简单的几发无训练的聚合器在这些提示之上改进了AUROC +0.14,优于跨代理环境的现有最佳探测器。 我们的项目可在https://github.com/mike-qz-wang/ASURE上查阅。

articles.title: Zero-shot narrative detection in social messaging
articles.content: This study investigates the zero-shot ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify and classify hidden narratives in social messages. Our research hypothesis is that LLMs' extensive contextual knowledge allows them to interpret messages on a deeper, pragmatic level, going beyond basic sentiment or topic analysis. Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of training examples. In contrast, automatically generated descriptions or the use of few examples (few-shot) often degrade accuracy due to subtle shifts in framing. The study also finds that ensemble methods, particularly majority voting, enhance robustness and that larger models perform best while also being less sensitive to prompt variations. The findings validate that LLMs can effectively detect strategic narratives in a zero-shot setting, and when combined with simple ensembling and human-written descriptions, they can rival supervised systems, offering a scalable solution for narrative detection, specially when there is no training data for the vast majority of domains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 社交讯息中的零镜头叙事检测
articles.content_zh: 本研究调查大型语言模型(LLMS)在社会信息中识别和分类隐藏叙事的零镜头能力. 我们的研究假设是,LLMs广泛的背景知识使得他们能够从更深入,务实的角度解读信息,超越基本情绪或专题分析. 在Dipromats和SemEval数据集上的实验显示,提供带有人文叙述描述的模型可以大大提高性能,而不需要培训实例. 相反,自动生成描述或使用少数实例(few-shot)往往会因为框架的微妙转变而降低准确性. 研究还发现,综合方法,特别是多数表决方法,增强了稳健性,较大的模型表现最好,同时也对迅速变化不太敏感. 调查结果证实,LLMS可以在零镜头设定下有效检测战略叙事,如果结合简单的综艺和人文描述,它们可以与受监督的系统竞争,为叙事检测提供一个可扩展的解决方案,特别是在绝大多数领域没有培训数据的情况下.

articles.title: Towards Illusions Awareness in Cyber-Physical System's Design
articles.content: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) operate through a continuous sense-compute-act loop within an open context environment, making it impossible to anticipate all the situations the system will face. To cope with this openness, stakeholders rely on assumptions, formalized into design models. However, these assumptions may no longer hold once the system is confronted with runtime reality, resulting in a discrepancy between expected and observed behaviour known in literature as the reality gap. Existing approaches mainly focus on reducing or overcoming it by making simulations more faithful to reality, with no unified methodology to structure and exploit invalidated assumptions that give rise to this gap as reusable design knowledge. We refer to the persistent reliance on invalidated assumptions -and the resulting false confidence in the design model's operational validity -as design illusions, and argue that they need to be made explicit, structured, and exploited as knowledge to support better design decisions. We propose a conceptual pipeline for illusions-awareness that identifies, classifies, characterizes, and leverages illusions to transform them into actionable design knowledge.

articles.title_zh: 实现网络物理系统设计中的幻觉意识
articles.content_zh: Cyber-Physical Systems(CPS)在一个开放的上下文环境中通过连续的感官计算-动作循环运行,使得无法预测系统将面临的所有情况. 为应对这种开放性,利益攸关方依赖各种假设,这些假设已正式纳入设计模式。 然而,一旦系统面临运行时间现实,这些假设可能就不再存在,导致文献中称为现实差距的预期行为和观察到的行为之间出现差异。 现有方法主要侧重于通过使模拟更忠实于现实来减少或克服它,没有统一的方法来结构和利用导致这一空白的无效假设作为可重复使用的设计知识. 我们提到对无效假设的持续依赖,以及由此造成的对设计模型操作有效性的虚假信任,是设计上的幻觉,并称这些假象需要作为知识加以明确、结构化和利用,以支持更好的设计决定。 我们提出一个概念管道 用于幻觉意识 识别,分类,定性, 并利用幻觉 把它们转化为可操作的设计知识。

articles.title: Persistent Recurrent Memory Between Transformer Layers - Improves Language Model Generalization
articles.content: We introduce a simple architectural modification to decoder-only transformers: a persistent recurrent state that observes hidden representations via cross-attention, updates itself through a GRU, and modulates subsequent processing via gated addition. Inserted between the lower and upper halves of a 6-layer transformer, this module adds only 3.7\% additional parameters while reducing evaluation loss from $2.438 \pm 0.004$ to $1.743 \pm 0.018$, corresponding to a 28.5\% reduction on held-out language modeling data. The improvement is statistically significant across 5 random seeds ($p < 0.01$) and corresponds to reduced overfitting (generalization gap 0.12 vs 0.26). Through controlled ablations, we demonstrate that the improvement stems entirely from the persistent memory topology, not from auxiliary self-prediction objectives. A model with identical topology but no auxiliary loss performs equivalently, while a random auxiliary loss provides no benefit. Representation probing reveals that the persistent state encodes narrative position (52\% vs 33\% chance level)---information that standard attention maintains less efficiently. Our results suggest that bridging transformer layers with a lightweight recurrent memory is a simple, effective approach to improving generalization in small-scale language models.

articles.title_zh: 变形器层之间的持续经常内存 - 改进语言模型通用化
articles.content_zh: 我们为解码器唯一的变压器引入了一个简单的建筑修改:一种持续的经常性状态,通过交叉注意来观察隐藏的表示,通过GRU来更新自己,并通过加闸来调节后续的处理. 本模块在6层变压器的下半身和上半身之间插入,只增加了3.7+%的附加参数,同时将评价损失从2.438\pm 0.004美元减少到1.743\pm 0.018美元,相当于停用语言模型数据减少28.5+%. 5种随机种子(p < 0.01美元)的改善在统计学上是显著的,这与减少过度配对(一般化差距0.12对0.26)相对应。 我们通过有控制的擦伤表明,改进完全源于持续的记忆地形,而不是辅助性的自我预测目标。 具有相同地形但无辅助损失的模型具有等效性,而随机辅助损失则无益. 代表调查显示,持续的状态编码了叙事立场(52\%对33\%的机会级别)————标准关注维持效率较低的信息. 我们的结果表明,具有轻量级经常性内存的桥式变压器层是一个简单有效的方法,可以改善小规模语言模型的通化.

articles.title: ECHO: Early-layer Collaborative Hierarchical Orchestration with Bonus Logits in Speculative Decoding
articles.content: While draft-model-free speculative decoding offers a promising path to efficient LLM inference, it is frequently constrained by stale draft candidates and the high computational cost of the verification. To address these challenges, we propose ECHO, a hierarchical dual-loop framework that exploits the functional asymmetry between LLM layers. Leveraging the high discriminative efficiency of early layers and the authoritative distribution of final layers, ECHO bifurcates inference into a high-frequency inner loop and a low-frequency outer loop. Within the inner loop, early-layer bonus logits drive rapid, multi-step draft-tree exploration at a minimal cost. Simultaneously, the outer loop performs authoritative full-model verification through a state-reuse mechanism. Crucially, the outer loop also utilizes final-layer bonus logits to correct existing paths and supplement the tree with high-confidence candidates for subsequent cycles. Experimental results across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that ECHO significantly boosts mean accepted tokens and achieves a 2.4$\times$ to 2.9$\times$ speedup, outperforming existing state-of-the-art baselines with negligible engineering overhead and no extra deployment parameters, albeit with a one-shot fine-tuning dependency for optimal acceleration. The code is available at https://github.com/whucs21Mzy/ECHO.

articles.title_zh: 欧共体人道处:早期协作级管弦乐团,在光谱解码中带有Bonus Logits
articles.content_zh: 虽然无模式草案的投机解码为有效进行LLM推论提供了一条有希望的道路,但经常受到过时的草稿候选人和核查的高计算成本的限制。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议欧共体人道处,一个利用LLM层之间功能不对称的分级双轨框架。 利用早期层的高差别效率以及最终层的权威分布,ECHO双规推论为高频内环和低频外环. 在内环内,早期的奖金记录器以最低的成本驱动快速,多步的草原探索. 同时,外环通过国家再利用机制进行权威的全模型核查。 关键的是,外环还利用最终级的奖金对数来修正现有路径,并以高自信的候选者来补充树,用于以后的周期. 各种基准的实验结果表明,欧洲人道处大大提升了接受的标志,达到2.4美元到2.9美元的速度,比现有最先进的基线业绩好,工程间接费用可忽略不计,而且没有额外的部署参数,尽管只有一发微调才能优化加速。 该代码见https://github.com/whucs21Mzy/ECHO.

articles.title: AraMIP: Extending MIPVU Towards Metaphor Identification in Arabic
articles.content: Metaphor research has gained increasing attention due to its relevance to linguistic creativity, language use, cognitive processes, and related areas. While many efforts have been devoted to metaphor identification and annotation in English and other languages, Arabic remains under-resourced in this area. In this work, we propose the Arabic Metaphor Identification Procedure (AraMIP), a novel guideline for Arabic metaphor annotation. AraMIP builds on the widely used Metaphor Identification Procedure Vrije Universiteit (MIPVU) framework, incorporating adaptations that accounts for the language-specific properties of Arabic. We distinguish three major types of Arabic figurative language: Isti'ara (metaphor), kinaya (metonymy/indirect expression), and tashbih (simile), and annotate a pilot dataset of 300 sentences (5277 words). Our analysis reveals key challenges specific to Arabic, including morphological complexity, inconsistencies in dictionary sense ordering, and the absence of standardized contextual materials for annotators. This work contributes a first step toward standardized Arabic figurative instances and facilitates the development of larger annotated resources, thereby supporting future research on figurative language in Arabic.

articles.title_zh: AraMIP: 扩展MIPVU 走向阿拉伯文的元代识别
articles.content_zh: Metaphor研究因其与语言创造力,语言使用,认知过程以及相关领域的相关性而日益受到关注. 虽然已作出许多努力,以英语和其他语言进行比喻识别和说明,但阿拉伯语在这方面仍然资源不足。 在这部作品中,我们提出了阿拉伯代谢识别程序(AraMIP),这是阿拉伯语代谢注释的新准则. AraMIP基于广泛使用的Metaphor识别程序Vrije Universityeit(MIPVU)框架,纳入了考虑到阿拉伯语语言特性的改编。 我们区分了三种主要类型的阿拉伯比喻语言:Isti'ara(metaphor),kinaya(metonymy/间接表达),和tashbih(sile),并注释了300句(5277字)的试点数据集. 我们的分析揭示了阿拉伯语特有的主要挑战,包括形态复杂性、词典意义上的不一致顺序,以及没有为注释者提供标准化的背景材料。 这项工作有助于朝着标准化的阿拉伯语模拟实例迈出第一步,并有助于开发更多的附加说明的资源,从而支持今后对阿拉伯语模拟语言的研究。

articles.title: Easy to Catch a Liar, Hard to Clear an Honest One: Language Models Diagnosing a Corrupted Reward Channel from a Verified Record
articles.content: An agent that learns from rewards has to trust whatever reports those rewards. When the reports suddenly change, either the world changed or the reporter broke. From the reports alone these are indistinguishable, and reinforcement learning theory shows that no amount of further experience separates them. The prescribed escape is richer data about the reporter itself. We ask whether a frozen language model, handed exactly that data, uses it. We build a two-option game in which a payout swap and a lying reporter produce byte-identical histories. Then we add one verified record: an independent check of one round's real result, printed beside what the reporter said about that round. That single line settles the case. We ask three large models, from two families, to answer one question with one letter. Is the reporter honest or lying? They catch a lying reporter almost perfectly. At the 70B class that holds in every condition we tried; the 32B model slips in one wording. They clear an honest reporter far less often, and how often depends on things that should not matter. Averaged over rounds, letters, and wordings, a 72B model calls an honest reporter a liar 38% of the time when nothing has changed at all, and 58% of the time when the payouts moved. A 70B model from a second family calls an honest reporter a liar 26% and 48% of the time. The failure is not one of reading, because in the situation where nothing changed the same models score 0.96 to 1.00 with the answer printed in the prompt. Which surface feature drives it differs by family. For the Qwen models it is which round the record names, and for Llama it is which letter stands for "honest." Adding the record to a prompt that already states the answer makes Llama less likely to give that answer. We had registered a prediction for that 58% before the run: 35%. The failure is larger than we expected.

articles.title_zh: 容易捕捉到骗子, 难于清除诚实的一个人: 语言模型从已验证的记录中诊断一个被腐蚀的奖励频道
articles.content_zh: 一个从奖赏中学习的代理人必须相信任何报告这些奖赏的内容. 当报告突然改变时,要么世界改变,要么记者崩溃. 仅从报告来看,这些是无法区分的,强化学习理论表明,没有多少进一步的经验将它们分开。 规定的越狱是更丰富的关于记者本身的数据. 我们问一个冷冻的语言模型, 准确的传递数据,是否使用它。 我们制作一个双选项游戏,其中一个付酬交换和一个说谎的记者产生字节相同的历史. 然后我们补充一个经过核实的记录: 独立检查一回合的真实结果, 印在记者所说的那一回合。 那条线解决了问题 我们请三个大模型,来自两个家庭, 用一个字母回答一个问题。 记者是诚实还是说谎? 他们抓住了一个说谎的记者 几乎完美。 在70B级,我们尝试了每一个条件;32B型在一种措辞中滑动。 他们为一位诚实的记者开脱的频率要低得多,而且多少时候取决于不应该有关系的事情。 72B模型平均将诚实的记者称为说谎者, 一个来自第二个家庭的70B模型称诚实的记者是说谎者,时间占26%和48%. 失败并非是阅读,因为在无事可改的情况下,同一型号的得分为0.96比1.00,并及时打印答案. 哪个表面特征驱动它因家族而异. 对于Quen模型来说,是哪一个环绕记录名称,对于Llama来说,是哪个字母代表"诚实". 将记录添加到已经说明答案的提示中,使得拉玛不太可能给出答案. 我们的预测显示 58% 运行前:35%。 失败比我们预期的要大。

articles.title: Psychological Effects of Cultural Upheavals from Millions of Song Lyrics Over 100 Years
articles.content: Cultural upheavals impact many aspects of social life, and many studies have investigated their impact on language patterns. However, few investigations have isolated the impact of upheavals on individuals at scale in popular media. The current work evaluated millions of song lyrics spanning more than a century in search of within-artist and between-artist signals of distress from the Vietnam War, the terrorist attacks of 9/11, and COVID-19. Compared to a five-year baseline, rates of self-references - a marker of psychological distancing - were significantly reduced after the Vietnam War and September 11th. Cognitive processing terms were elevated post-upheaval vs. pre-upheaval, which indicated artists' increased attempts to make meaning from such massive disruptions. Content patterns corroborated these findings as artists wrote more about "life and freedom" (societal conditions) and less about "courtship and nightlife" (interpersonal connection) following the upheavals. Cultural upheavals modify individual and collective verbal behavior, demonstrating their far-reaching impact on society.

articles.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
articles.content: Looped Transformers achieve strong performance with compact parameter sizes by repeatedly applying a shared stack of Transformer blocks across recurrent depths. However, they incur higher decoding latency than standard Transformer models of comparable parameter size because shared weights are accessed at every recurrent depth. To improve decoding efficiency, self-speculative decoding is particularly well suited to Looped Transformers, as their intermediate recurrent states can directly provide draft predictions without an auxiliary draft model. We therefore propose LoopSpec, a training-free self-speculative decoding framework tailored for Looped Transformers. LoopSpec extracts draft tokens from early recurrent states and operates in a pipelined manner, overlapping draft generation of future tokens with target verification of the current token. To improve draft accuracy without excessive compute overhead, we introduce a selective second proposal from deeper recurrent depth while ensuring lossless decoding under both greedy and sampling regimes. Furthermore, we derive the optimal proposal depths in closed form and show the prediction matches measurement. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, LoopSpec achieves up to 6.83$\times$ inference speedup across diverse Looped Transformers.

articles.title_zh: 循环Spec:循环变换器的管道自定义解码
articles.content_zh: 循环变形器通过反复应用共享堆积的变形器块跨越经常性深度,以紧凑参数大小实现强性能. 然而,它们比具有可比参数大小的标准变形器模型产生更高的解码间隔,因为共享的权重在每个经常性深度都可以访问. 为了提高解码效率,自猜解码特别适合循环变形器,因为其中间的反复状态可以在没有辅助草稿模型的情况下直接提供草稿预测. 因此,我们提议LoopSpec,一个适合Looped Transformers的无培训自定义解码框架。 LoopSpec从早期的反复状态中提取草稿令牌,并以管道化的方式运行,与当前令牌的目标验证重叠的未来令牌的草稿生成. 为了提高草案的准确性,同时避免过度计算间接费用,我们从更深的重复深度提出有选择的第二项建议,同时确保在贪婪和抽样制度下进行无损失的解码。 此外,我们以封闭的形式得出最佳提案深度,并显示预测匹配量。 纵观推理和编码基准,LoopSpec在各种Looped变形器之间实现最高6.83美元\times$的推论加速.

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Counterfactual Self-Explanations in LLMs
articles.content: Large language models can easily generate explanations for their own outputs, but such self-explanations are not necessarily faithful to the model's behavior. We study this issue through counterfactual self-explanations, where a model minimally edits an input so that its own prediction changes. Across sentiment analysis and natural language inference, we evaluate ten instruction-tuned models from the LLaMA-3 and Qwen-2.5 families, measuring faithfulness, minimality, and alignment with human-annotated rationales. Our results show that model scale is the strongest determinant of explanation quality: larger models are substantially more likely to generate counterfactuals that flip their own predictions and target decision-relevant evidence. In contrast, the rationale-guided condition produces edit-minimal counterfactuals that are also more human-aligned. However, it does not consistently improve faithfulness. Overall, counterfactual self-explanations can provide useful behavioral evidence about model decisions, but their reliability depends strongly on model capacity and should be empirically validated rather than assumed.

articles.title_zh: 法学硕士中反事实自我解释的经验研究
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型可以很容易地产生对自己输出的解释,但这种自我阐释不一定忠实于模型的行为. 我们通过反事实自我解释来研究这个问题,一个模型对一个输入进行最小的编辑,以便自己的预测发生变化. 在情感分析和自然语言推论中,我们评价了LLaMA-3和Quen-2.5家庭的10个指导性调整模型,衡量忠诚度、最小度和与人类附加说明的理论相一致。 我们的结果表明,模型尺度是解释质量的最强决定因素:更大的模型产生反事实的可能性大得多,从而推翻自己的预测和目标决定相关证据。 与此相对照,原理引导条件产生编辑-最小反事实,这些反事实也更符合人性. 然而,它并没有始终如一地提高忠诚。 总的来说,反事实自我解释可以为模型决定提供有用的行为证据,但其可靠性在很大程度上取决于模型能力,应当通过经验验证而不是假设.

articles.title: Shared-Prefix KV Reuse Across Standard LoRA Adapters: Quality and Serving Tradeoffs
articles.content: A common small-model deployment runs one shared backbone with several LoRA specialists that answer over the same context. Serving them naively re-prefills that shared context once per specialist. We study a narrow, practical question: for already-trained standard LoRA adapters -- not adapters retrained for cache compatibility -- how much task quality is preserved if the backbone's prefill KV cache is computed once and reused across specialists, and what does that buy in serving cost? On a Qwen3-1.7B backbone with two adapters (extractive QA on HotpotQA, arithmetic reasoning on GSM8K), we sweep the boundary at which the specialist takes over from the reused base cache and measure paired quality differences and serving cost. Full-prefix reuse had the lowest prefill cost and a small quality difference on held-out GSM8K (Delta = -4.6 EM at a 160-token budget; -3.0 at 320 tokens; -0.8 under a second training seed -- all favoring native, only the first excluding zero, and the magnitude not consistent). Partial recomputation provided no demonstrated advantage. Neither quality equivalence nor a general boundary-selection rule is established. We also report a closed-form ridge KV translator that did not beat direct reuse, and specialist-dependence contrasts whose intervals all include zero. The measured serving benefit is warm-cache time-to-first-token, which grows with context (~16x at 8K); two-branch peak memory was only 12% lower and, on inspection, the prefix was never physically shared across branches -- this implementation reuses KV values but copies their storage, so shared-cache memory savings are not achieved.

articles.title_zh: 共享前缀 KV 跨标准LORA调整器重用:质量与服务取舍
articles.content_zh: 一个通用的小型模型部署有一个共享的主干网,由若干洛拉专家负责同一背景。 让他们天真地重新做预科 一次分享每个专家的背景 我们研究了一个狭义的,实用的问题:对于已经训练好的标准的LORA适配器,而不是为了缓存兼容性而重新训练的适配器,如果主干线的预填 KV缓存被计算一次并跨专家重复使用,那么保存了多少任务质量,这在服务成本中能买多少? 在一个带有两个适配器的Quen3-1.7B主干线上(提取热点QA上的QA,GSM8K上的算术推理),我们扫清了专家从复用基缓存中接管的边界,并测量质量差异和服务成本的配对. 全前置再利用在被搁置的GSM8K(Delta = -4.6 EM,按160个托肯预算;-320个令牌;-0.8在第二个训练种子下 -- -- 都倾向于本土,只有第一个不包括零,且其规模不一致)上具有最低的预填成本和质量差异。 部分重算没有显示出任何优势。 没有确立质量等同或一般边界选择规则。 我们还报告说,一个封闭式的脊脊KV翻译没有超越直接再利用,专家依赖性对比,其间隔都为零。 测得的服务效益是温暖卡切时间到第一卡切时间,它随上下文(~16x at 8K)而增长;两分支峰值内存只低12%,在检查时,前缀从未在分支间实际共享——这个执行重用KV值但复制其存储,因此共享卡切内存的节省没有实现.

articles.title: Interactive Memory Learning for Long-Term Conversations
articles.content: Recent advancements in large language models have significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents in modeling long-term conversations. Despite these successes, existing approaches typically adopt a static heuristic paradigm, where information is passively archived without adaptive memory valuation. Consequently, these methods fail to self-evolve or align their memory management with evolving user needs. To address this, we propose ICML (InteraCtive Memory Learning), a multi-agent framework that transforms the memory mechanism from a passive archive into a learnable, interactive memory policy. Specifically, we first employ a session synthesis pipeline to generate expert data, facilitating rapid test-time adaptation in unseen scenarios. Building on this, ICML utilizes an online reinforcement learning mechanism where a Planner agent selectively encodes high-value information and a Trigger agent dynamically retrieves it to optimize response quality, whereby the two agents co-evolve through continuous interaction feedback. Crucially, both agents are synchronized through a delayed reward mechanism that propagates future feedback back to earlier storage decisions, ensuring memory policies are precisely aligned with user expectations. Experimental results demonstrate that ICML significantly outperforms strong baselines, exhibiting the unique capability to continuously improve response quality as interactions accumulate.

articles.title_zh: 长期对话的互动记忆学习
articles.content_zh: 最近大语言模型的进步大大增强了代理者在模拟长期对话方面的能力. 尽管取得了这些成功,但现有办法通常采用静态的热力学模式,即被动地将信息存档,而不进行适应性记忆评估。 因此,这些方法不能自行演变或使其内存管理符合不断变化的用户需求。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出ICML(InteraCtive Memory Learning),这是一个多代理框架,将内存机制从被动存档转变为可学习,互动的内存政策. 具体而言,我们首先利用会议综合管道生成专家数据,便利在不为人知的情况下快速进行试验时间适应。 在此基础上,ICML利用在线强化学习机制,由计划员代理有选择地编码高值信息,并由触发员动态检索,以优化响应质量,通过持续互动反馈,两个代理员共同演化. 关键的是,通过延迟的奖励机制,两种代理都同步进行,将未来的反馈传播回早期的存储决定,确保内存政策与用户的预期准确一致. 实验结果表明,ICML显著超过强基线,显示出在相互作用累积时不断提高反应质量的独特能力。

articles.title: EviScope: Paired Counterfactual Evidence Diagnostics for Faithful and Efficient Grounded Language Models
articles.content: Grounded language-model systems are often evaluated by final answer accuracy, yet a correct answer can be unsupported, drawn from the wrong source, or produced when evidence is insufficient or contradictory. We introduce EviScope, a paired counterfactual benchmark that holds the question fixed while adding, removing, distracting, or contradicting its evidence. EviScope-v1.1 contains 40 four-condition quartets with repaired counterfactual claims and span-level support labels for automatic evaluation. Across 960 gold-blind generations from Qwen2.5-7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemini 3.5 Flash, paired metrics expose model-dependent grounding behavior that answer accuracy hides. On two local open models, an explicit evidence-action gate underperforms vanilla RAG on QCS: 0.15 vs. 0.50 for Qwen and 0.10 vs. 0.375 for Llama. Gemini reaches 0.944 joint success under both prompts, yet still answers 5% of conflict cases after contradiction insertion. EviScope therefore distinguishes unsupported answering, conflict blindness, and wrong non-answer actions rather than scoring answers alone.

articles.title_zh: EviScope:为忠实和高效的基础语言模型而作的Paired反事实证据诊断
articles.content_zh: 基础语言模型系统往往通过最终的答案准确性来评价,然而正确的答案可能得不到支持,来自错误的来源,或者在证据不充分或自相矛盾时产生. 我们引入了EviScope,一个对等的反事实基准,它把问题固定下来,同时添加,去除,分心,或者反驳它的证据. EviScope-v1.1包含40个四条件四重奏,并有修复的反事实索赔和跨级支持标签用于自动评价. 跨越了从Quen2.5-7B,Llama 3.1 8B,和双子座 3.5 Flash 的960个金盲世代,双子相配的度量衡暴露出依赖模型的地底行为,答案准确性隐藏. 在两个本地开放型号上,一个明确的证据-动作门在QCS上的"香草RAG"表现不佳:克文0.15对0.50,拉玛0.10对0.375. 双子座在两个提示下都取得了0.944项联合成功,然而在矛盾插入后仍能回答5%的冲突案件. 因此,EviScope区分了无支持的回答,冲突失明,以及错误的非回答行动,而不是单独给答案打分.

articles.title: Audio-Visual Turn-taking Prediction in Cocktail Party Scenarios
articles.content: Current predictive turn-taking models (PTTMs) achieve strong performance on benchmarks with controlled acoustic conditions and clean audio signals. Their generalisation to conversations with overlapping speech and background interference remains underexplored. In this research, we evaluate audio-visual PTTMs trained with clean data on a challenging cocktail-party testbed derived from the AVCocktail dataset, and analyse their adaptation behaviour to this new domain. Experimental results show consistent performance degradation across audio and visual modalities under noisy conditions, with up to 38% relative drop in weighted F1. Fine-tuning on the new domain improves robustness, but gains vary across modalities and depend on the size of the available pre-training data. These findings provide insights into the different generalisation and adaptation capabilities of the audio and visual modalities, and indicate the need for robust modelling strategies to adapt to the complexities of human interactions in noise. All code and turn labels are made publicly available to facilitate further research.

articles.title_zh: 鸡尾酒会的视听转换预测
articles.content_zh: 目前的预测性转向模型(PTTM)在具有可控声学条件和干净音频信号的基准上取得了强效. 它们被概括为与重叠的言论和背景干扰的对话,仍然没有得到充分利用。 在这项研究中,我们评价视听PTTMs对来自AVCocktail数据集的具有挑战性的鸡尾酒派对试验台进行清洁数据培训,并分析其适应这一新领域的行为。 实验结果显示,在噪音条件下,各种音频和视觉模式的性能持续退化,加权F1相对下降高达38%。 对新领域进行微调可以提高稳健性,但收益因方式而异,取决于现有培训前数据的规模。 这些调查结果深入了解了视听模式的不同通俗化和适应能力,并表明需要强有力的建模战略来适应噪音中人类相互作用的复杂性。 所有代码和转弯标签都公开提供,以便于进一步研究。

articles.title: Diagnosing the Fact-Grounding Gap in Multi-Hop Question Answering
articles.content: Multi-hop question answering requires combining information from multiple documents to answer complex questions. These systems have grown increasingly capable, yet when they fail, the error is typically attributed to not finding the right documents. Whether this holds at the level of individual reasoning steps remains largely unexamined. We investigate this across three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks and find that failures decompose into two distinct modes: retrieval failures, where the needed passage was not retrieved, and extraction failures, where the passage was retrieved but the needed fact could not be extracted - a phenomenon we term the fact-grounding gap. Extraction failures account for nearly half of all per-hop deficiencies and are invisible to standard retrieval metrics. They remain unresolved by every retrieval intervention we test, establishing a ceiling for retrieval-only improvements. The gap's severity varies across benchmarks and question types, but extraction failures appear on every dataset we measure. Our findings reveal that retrieval failures and extraction failures are fundamentally different bottlenecks requiring different solutions - a distinction absent from current evaluation practice.

articles.title_zh: 分析多题回答中的事实组合差距
articles.content_zh: 多跳问答需要将多个文档中的信息组合起来回答复杂的问题. 这些系统的能力已日益增强,但当它们失败时,错误通常归因于找不到正确的文件。 这一点是否属于个别推理步骤,基本上仍未得到审查。 我们通过三个标准的多跳QA基准来调查这一点,发现失败会分解成两种不同的模式:检索失败(因为所需的通道没有取回)和取出失败(因为通道被取回了,但所需要的事实却无法取出)——这种现象我们称之为事实的取出差距. 采掘失败占了每起采掘缺陷总数的近一半,在标准检索指标中是看不见的。 我们测试的每一次检索干预都还没有解决,为只改进检索规定了上限。 差距的严重程度因基准和问题类型而异,但提取失败出现在我们测量的每一个数据集上. 我们的研究结果表明,检索失败和取出失败是根本不同的瓶颈,需要不同的解决方法,而目前的评价做法没有这种区别。

articles.title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents
articles.content: Lifelong conversational agents rely on memory systems to maintain deep, context-aware interactions with users. However, existing explicit textual memory pipelines suffer from a severe information bottleneck, often losing subtle behavioral patterns and emotional shifts. Furthermore, being typically static post-deployment, they cannot autonomously adapt to personal habits and preferences without manual feedback. Cognitive science, however, suggests that humans maintain mental models purely in a latent space and continuously refine them through predictive coding. Inspired by this, we propose \textbf{ThinkFlow}, a novel end-to-end latent memory framework for lifelong conversational agents. ThinkFlow bypasses the text bottleneck by dynamically compressing conversational flows into probabilistic latent memory skills, autonomously consolidating complex user states into disentangled, continuous vectors without semantic interference. To break this barrier, we introduce a test-time evolution paradigm. By coupling teacher-guided latent alignment to bootstrap the initial state with a self-supervised next-user-utterance prediction task for continuous refinement, the framework successfully overcomes cold-start challenges and achieves label-free lifelong personalization. Extensive experiments on long-term conversation benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkFlow significantly outperforms prevailing memory systems, providing highly personalized and contextually accurate responses over extended multi-session interactions.

articles.title_zh: ThinkFlow: 终身对话代理的自演概率主义后期记忆
articles.content_zh: 终身对话代理依赖于内存系统来保持与用户的深度,上下文感的互动. 然而,现有的明确的文字记忆管道受到严重的信息瓶颈所困扰,往往会失去微妙的行为模式和情感转变. 此外,由于部署后一般是静态的,没有人工反馈,他们无法自主地适应个人习惯和喜好。 然而,认知科学表明,人类将精神模型纯粹维持在潜伏的空间中,并通过预测编码不断完善. 受此启发,我们提出\textbf{ ThinkFlow}, 一个全新的从头到尾的潜在记忆框架,供终身对话代理人使用。 ThinkFlow通过动态地将对话流压缩为概率潜伏的内存技能来绕过文本瓶颈,自主地将复杂的用户状态整合为分解出,连续的向量而不受语义干扰. 为了突破这个障碍,我们引入了一个测试时间演化范式. 通过将教师指导的潜在调整与自我监督的下一个用户 -- -- 用户 -- -- 用户预测任务结合起来,使初始状态与持续改进相结合,该框架成功地克服了冷启动挑战,实现了无标签的终身个性化。 关于长期对话基准的广泛实验表明,ThinkFlow明显超越了通行的内存系统,在扩展多会话互动中提供了高度个性化和上下文准确的反应.

articles.title: Can LLMs Follow the Pulse of a Crisis? Evaluating Crisis Sentiment in Bangladesh's July Uprising
articles.content: Crisis sentiment analysis is especially challenging for low-resource languages such as Bangla, where language, context, and public reaction shift rapidly. We introduce UNRESTSENT200K, a Bangla crisis sentiment dataset with approximately 200K Facebook and YouTube comments from the July-August 2024 Bangladesh uprising. The dataset covers five event-aligned phases, from early escalation and internet blackout to regime transition and a later flood crisis. Each comment is linked to its parent post, enabling evaluation with and without discourse context. All comments are annotated through a fully human process involving 14 native Bangla-speaking annotators and senior validation, achieving substantial agreement (kappa = 0.73, alpha = 0.71) and 94.2% blind-audit agreement. We benchmark fine-tuned encoders, prompted LLMs, and LoRA-tuned LLMs. Results show that parent-post context consistently improves performance, while temporal shift across phases causes large performance drops. Strong LLMs perform well, but still struggle with sarcasm, implicit political references, and phase-dependent meaning. UNRESTSENT200K provides a benchmark for studying context-aware and temporally robust sentiment analysis in low-resource crisis discourse. UNRESTSENT200K is available at https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT200K/

articles.title_zh: LLMS能跟随危机的脉搏吗? 评估孟加拉国7月起义中的危机因素
articles.content_zh: 危机情绪分析对诸如孟加拉语等低资源语言来说尤其具有挑战性,因为孟加拉语的语言,背景以及公众的反应都迅速转变. 我们介绍UNRESTSENT 200K, 一个孟加拉危机情绪数据集, 该数据集涵盖从早期升级和互联网断电到政权过渡以及后一洪灾等五个事件相适应阶段. 每项评论都与其上级职位相挂钩,使评价能够有讨论背景或没有讨论背景。 所有评论都是通过一个完全人性化的过程加以说明的,其中涉及14名讲孟加拉语的土著注释员和高级鉴定员,达成了实质性协议(kappa=0.73,alpha=0.71)和94.2%的盲-审计协议。 我们以微调编码器、激励LLMs和LORA调制LLMs为基准。 结果显示,上级员额的情况持续改善业绩,而各阶段的时间变化导致业绩大幅下降。 强力LLMS表现良好,但仍与讽刺,隐含的政治参考,以及相依赖的意义相争. UNRESTSENT200K为在低资源危机讨论中研究对背景的认识和时间的强烈情绪分析提供了一个基准。 UNRESTSENT 200K可在https://sami0055.github.io/UNRESTSENT 200K/上查阅。

articles.title: PaperDoctor: Evidence-Grounded and Actionable Feedback for Scientific Papers in Progress
articles.content: Autoresearch agents are reshaping the research ecosystem, but they can also let flawed claims enter the literature at scale. Human advisors catch such issues in drafts through careful, traceable feedback, yet advisor-style assessment requires extensive manual effort and does not scale. To shift automated paper assessment from a judge to a diagnostician, we introduce PaperDoctor, an agent framework for pre-submission feedback with three key innovations. First, a holistic hierarchical framework evaluates writing, layout, references, code, theory, prior work, and experiments through three layers: L1 surface screening, L2 typed verifiers that route each claim to the appropriate evidence, and L3 reproducers that rerun experiments by priority. Second, each finding contains an observation, a pointer to specific evidence such as a sentence, equation, or code line, and a revision suggestion, making critiques auditable and actionable. Third, PaperDoctor selectively rebuilds and reruns experiments based on claim importance and compute budget, surfacing reproducibility gaps and quantitative limitations that are invisible from the manuscript alone. We evaluate PaperDoctor on 30 in-progress papers, yielding 70.6% agreement and all positive holistic scores, and on 40 manuscripts across machine learning, natural science, and social science, covering human- and AI-authored papers with code. Overall, PaperDoctor produces more auditable feedback than human and other agentic reviewers, pairs critiques with concrete suggestions by design, and complements dimensions often overlooked by human reviewers. We also develop an interactive interface that lets authors browse findings grounded in their paper. PaperDoctor reframes automated paper assessment as diagnosis rather than verdict, taking a concrete step toward AI advisors for more rigorous AI-assisted scientific discovery.

articles.title_zh: 论文医生:对正在编写的科学论文进行证据分析和可采取行动的反馈
articles.content_zh: 自动研究代理人正在重塑研究生态系统,但他们也可以让有缺陷的主张大规模地输入文献. 人类顾问通过仔细、可追踪的反馈在草案中抓住这些问题,但顾问式的评估需要大量人工努力,而不是规模。 为了将自动的纸面评估从法官转向诊断师,我们引入了PaperDoctor,这是一个具有三大创新的提交前反馈的代理框架。 首先,一个整体的分级框架通过三层来评价写作,布局,参考,代码,理论,之前的工作,以及实验:L1表面筛选,L2键入验证器,将每个主张引向适当的证据,以及L3复制器,按优先级重进行实验. 第二,每项调查结果都包含一项意见、对具体证据的指针,如句子、等式或代码行,以及修订建议,使批评可以审计和可采取行动。 第三,PaperDoctor有选择地根据主张重要性和计算预算来重建和再运行实验,表面重现可复制性差距和仅从手稿中看不到的数量限制. 我们评价了30份进步论文,获得70.6%的协议和所有积极的整体分数,评价了40份涉及机器学习、自然科学和社会科学的手稿,涵盖人类和AI撰写的有密码的论文。 总体而言,PaperDoctor比人和其他代理审查者产生更多的可审计反馈,通过设计将批评与具体建议结合起来,并补充人类审查者经常忽略的维度. 我们还开发了一个互动界面,让作者浏览其论文中的结论。 PaperDoctor将自动纸张评估重新设定为诊断而不是判断,向AI顾问迈出了更严格的AI辅助科学发现的具体步骤.

articles.title: The Role of Implicit and Explicit Demographic Signals in Large Language Model-based Student Assessment
articles.content: Large Language Models are now common in student assessment, but we know little about how student demographics affect their use. Sometimes, considering student demographics may be necessary -- for example, to improve readability for users with lower educational levels. However, it also risks being a cause of discrimination, e.g., when assigning lower scores to students from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. We set up controlled prompts to test 1) explicit demographic effects, where we mention demographic details directly, and 2) implicit effects, where we use conversation history as a demographic signal. We test these settings in three tasks: Automated Essay Scoring, Formative Feedback, and Metalinguistic Question Answering. We test six state-of-the-art LLMs on these tasks. In both explicit and implicit cases, the models pick up on demographic cues and can change their scoring, feedback, and answers accordingly. We find that LLMs frequently adjust the readability of feedback to education levels when these are explicitly mentioned. On the other hand, implicit conditions produce unpredictable biases, such as in question answering, where responses from lower-education levels receive lower sentiment scores. Our results provide clear evidence of demographic sensitivity in LLMs for educational assessment tasks.

articles.title_zh: 基于大语模式的学生评估中隐含和明确的人口信号的作用
articles.content_zh: 大语言 目前模式在学生评估中很常见,但我们对学生人口统计学如何影响其使用知之甚少. 有时,考虑到学生人口统计可能是必要的 -- -- 例如,提高教育水平较低的使用者的可读性。 然而,它也有可能成为歧视的原因,例如在向社会经济背景较低的学生分配较低的分数时。 我们设置了可控的提示以测试 1 明确的人口效应,我们直接提到人口细节 2 隐含效应,我们用对话历史作为人口信号. 我们在三个任务中测试这些设置:自动分析分解、格式反馈和金属金通问答。 我们测试了六个最先进的LLMs 关于这些任务。 在明确和隐含的情况下,这些模型都从人口统计提示中取出,并可以相应改变其评分、反馈和答案。 我们发现,在明确提到反馈时,法学硕士经常将反馈的可读性调整到教育程度。 另一方面,隐含的条件会产生无法预测的偏差,比如在回答问题时,低教育水平的答复得到的情绪分数较低. 我们的成果清楚地证明,在教育评估任务中,法学硕士课程的人口敏感性。

articles.title: Autoformalizing Argumentative Material Inferences
articles.content: Natural language arguments are compelling before they are formally explicit. A premise supports a claim through defeasible warrants, background commitments, and exception conditions that the text leaves implicit. However, formal verification requires the opposite. Making such arguments machine-checkable requires constructing the missing commitments, not only translating given sentences into logic. Construction, however, carries a risk that translation does not: a system free to add premises can make any claim provable, and a formally valid proof may assert the claim outright, prove it without the original premise, or establish more than the claim itself. We address this problem by formulating autoformalization for argumentative material inference as guard completion, in which non-monotonic material support is turned into monotonic formal inference relative to an explicitly constructed guard set. A completion is accepted only when its proof both passes the theorem prover and survives contrastive tests of premise dependence and claim selectivity. We implement this formulation in GUARD, a neuro-symbolic framework in which LLMs construct and formalize candidate guards, Isabelle/HOL verifies the resulting theories and returns step-level feedback for iterative refinement, and the system abstains when no faithful completion can be reached. Our empirical results on Debatepedia and ARCT using different LLMs demonstrate that GUARD yields significant improvements in verified-faithful (+35.3, +32.9 points) and substantial reductions in leakage (-25.9, -21.9 points) over the state-of-the-art LLM-driven theorem proving approach. Moreover, we show that the symbolic soft critique and the explicit assumption layer account for most of these gains, with the soft critique also improving the initial validity of the elicited context and reducing the number of iterations required for successful verification.

articles.title_zh: 自动正规化论证材料推论
articles.content_zh: 自然语言的论据在正式明确之前是令人信服的。 一个前提通过无法使用的逮捕证、背景承诺和案文所隐含的例外条件来支持索赔要求。 然而,正式的核查要求相反。 要使这种论点可以机器核对,就必须建立缺失的承诺,而不只是将判决转化为逻辑。 然而,建筑工程有翻译不翻译的风险:免费增加房地的系统可以证明任何索赔要求,正式有效的证据可以直接提出索赔要求,在没有原始前提的情况下证明索赔要求,或者证明超出索赔要求本身。 我们通过制定自动正规化来解决这个问题,将论证材料推论作为警卫完成,在这种程序中,相对于一个明确建造的警卫装置,非模拟材料支持转变为单一的正式推论。 只有当其证明既通过了定理证明,又经受了对前提依赖和主张选择性的对比性测试时,才接受完成。 我们在GUARD中执行这一表述,这是一个神经-同义框架,LLMS在其中构建和正式确定候选警卫,Isabelle/HOL验证由此产生的理论并返回阶梯级反馈,以进行迭代完善,当无法做到忠实完成时,系统就弃权. 我们使用不同的LLMs进行的关于 " 辩论 " 和 " ARCT " 的经验结果表明,GUARD在核实真实性(+35.3,+32.9分)和大量减少渗出(-25.9分,-21.9分)方面比最先进的LLM驱动定理证明方法大有改进。 此外,我们表明,象征性的软批评和明确的假设层占了这些进展的大部分,而软批评也改善了所引出的背景的初步有效性并减少了成功核查所需的重复次数。

articles.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs
articles.content: Open-weight language models publish the strings their chat templates use to mark turns, roles and tool results, which the tokenizer maps back to the reserved identifiers the model obeys. Anyone who controls text in a prompt can therefore write a turn boundary indistinguishable from one the serving stack wrote. We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems rely on. We propose nameless tokenization, which leaves the control entries with a reserved identifier and no surface string, so the content encoder cannot emit one and message content reaches the model unaltered. Across five tokenizer families it reproduces the standard token stream exactly on attack-free data and lifts accuracy on a probe of delimiter-bearing text from 8.5% to 59.9%, where sanitizers lose it. Separating a delimiter's appearance from its identifier shows the identifier matters little against a bare task instruction, but carries most of a forged tool result and most of any forged turn once the system message tells the model to treat user content as data.

articles.title_zh: 无名Tokenization:Open-Wight LLMs中的无名Tokenizer-Level防控-Token Forgery
articles.content_zh: 开放量级语言模型发布其用于标记转折,角色和工具结果的聊天模板所使用的字符串,而标语符将标语符映射回所保留的标识符,使模型服从. 因此,任何在提示中控制文本的人都可以写出一个转弯边界,与服务堆栈所写的一个无法区分。 我们审计了256个聊天信号器 这一切都是可伪造的,通常推荐作为固定的旗帜留下56.6%可伪造,因为它错过了工具和推理标记代理系统所依赖的. 我们提出无名代号化,使控制条目保留了标识符,没有表面字符串,因此内容编码器不能放出一个,消息内容到达模型时没有改变. 它通过5个标致活化器家族 完全根据无攻击数据复制标准标致流 并且将含有分界器的文本探测器的精确度从8.5%提高到59.9%, 在那里消毒器失去它。 将分隔器的外观从它的标识符中分离出来,可以显示标识符事项很少与赤裸的任务指令相抗衡,而是携带了大部分被伪造的工具结果和大部分被伪造的转盘,一旦系统消息告诉模型将用户内容视为数据.

articles.title: Target-Language Generation in Multilingual Models: Activation Steering and Optimal Control
articles.content: Ensuring that multilingual language models generate coherent text in a specific target language is a major issue in multilingual language modeling. We develop an optimal control method for target-language text generation as well as a framework for evaluating the quality of generated text in terms of language adherence, linguistic coherence, and semantic coherence. We find that the proposed method performs at least as well as the prominent difference-in-means activation steering method for the majority of models tested, with substantially less hyperparameter tuning required.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多种语言的目标语言生成 模型:激活引导和优化控制
articles.content_zh: 确保多语种语言模型以特定的目标语言生成一致的文本,是多语种语言模型化中的一个主要问题. 我们为目标语文文本生成制定最佳控制方法,并为评价生成文本在语言坚持性、语言一致性和语义一致性方面的质量制定框架。 我们发现,拟议方法至少对大多数已测试的模型进行显著的异同活化引导方法,要求的超参数调取量要少得多。

articles.title: HUMAID-NER: A Disaster Tweet Dataset for Joint Named Entity Recognition and Event Classification via Uncertainty-Weighted Multitask Learning
articles.content: Rapid extraction of structured information from social media is important for humanitarian response, yet existing disaster tweet resources mainly provide document-level category labels without span-level entity annotations. We introduce HUMAID-NER, the first named entity recognition dataset built on the HumAID benchmark, containing 60,000 English disaster tweets annotated in BIO format across ten operationally motivated entity types and yielding approximately 175,000 labelled entity spans. Annotations are generated through a reproducible three-stage hybrid pipeline combining a spaCy transformer model, disaster-domain EntityRuler patterns, and structured regular expressions with priority-based overlap resolution. We also propose a joint multitask learning framework that performs disaster-specific named entity recognition and humanitarian event classification using a shared RoBERTa-large encoder. To reduce task conflict during joint training, the model uses homoscedastic uncertainty weighting with learnable task parameters and a two-stage training schedule that freezes the lower 18 of 24 encoder layers in the second stage. On the HUMAID-NER validation set, the proposed system achieves NER span micro-F1 of 0.841 and classification macro-F1 of 0.761 simultaneously. A real-time web dashboard demonstrates end-to-end deployment. The dataset, models, and pipeline code are released to support reproducibility and future crisis informatics research.

articles.title_zh: HUMAID-NER:用于通过不确定的加权多任务学习进行联合命名实体识别和事件分类的灾害调频数据集
articles.content_zh: 从社交媒体上快速取出结构化信息对于人道主义响应很重要,然而现有的灾害推特资源主要提供文档级别类别标签而无需跨级别实体说明. 我们引入了HUMAID-NER,这是第一个基于HumAID基准的命名实体识别数据集,包含以BIO格式标注的60,000个英文灾难推文,涉及10个具有业务动机的实体类型,并产生了约175,000个标注的实体跨度. 说明是通过可再生的三相混合管来生成的,结合了温泉 Cy变压器模型,灾难域实体调节器模式,以及结构化的正则表达式,并基于优先级的重叠分辨率. 我们还建议建立一个联合的多任务学习框架,使用一个共用的RoBERTa大编码器,对具体灾害实体进行命名确认和人道主义活动分类。 为了减少联合训练期间的任务冲突,该模型使用可学习的任务参数的同质不确定性权重和在第二阶段冻结了24个编码器层中下18个的两级训练时间表. 在HUMAID-NER验证集上,所拟议的系统同时实现NER跨度为0.841微F1和分类宏-F10.761. 实时网络仪表板显示端到端的部署. 发布数据集,模型和管线代码,以支持可再生性和未来的危机信息学研究.

articles.title: Verbalizing Subliminal Learning Effects Using Text Optimization
articles.content: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in which a distillation dataset transmits traits from the teacher model that are not legibly encoded in the dataset itself. This introduces a new challenge for model development and creates new risks from data poisoning. In this work, we use text optimization to detect subliminal learning effects and describe them as legible prompts. Subliminal learning from a prompted teacher motivates our approach. We observe that this is a special case of context distillation and leverage this observation to show that, in theory, the prompted subliminal learning dataset identifies the teacher's prompt. We reduce recovering this prompt to a text optimization problem and present a method to approximately solve it. Our method, SALVE (Search-Aided Latent Verbalization), optimizes a soft prompt, queries the same model to verbalize it as text, and uses beam search to make the verbalization reliable. In the standard subliminal learning setting, SALVE reliably recovers legible prompts that name the teacher's trait, while common text optimization methods fail to do so. In addition, we find that there are settings in which SALVE recovers the teacher's trait from a dataset even when subliminal learning fails, but that modifying student training to improve context distillation can create subliminal learning effects. We lastly show that SALVE detects subliminal learning effects in three additional settings: (1) mixtures of subliminal learning data and unrelated data, (2) data generated when the teacher is biased via activation steering, and (3) subsets of real preference data selected via Logit-Linear Selection. Overall, our results deepen our understanding of subliminal learning and present SALVE as a method to proactively detect subliminal learning effects.

articles.title_zh: 使用文本优化对子读取学习效果
articles.content_zh: 潜入式学习是一种现象,即蒸馏数据集传递出师范模型的特质,这些特质在数据集本身无法清晰地编码. 这给模型的开发带来了新的挑战并造成了数据中毒的新风险. 在这部作品中,我们使用文本优化来检测下意识的学习效果,并把它们描述为可分辨的提示. 从一位有激励力的老师那里 潜意识的学习激励着我们的方法 我们观察到,这是背景蒸馏的特例,并利用这种观察来表明,在理论上,被激发的子脑学习数据集识别出老师的快感. 我们把恢复此快取简化为文本优化问题,并提出一种方法来大致解决它。 我们的方法"SALVE"(Search-Aided Latetnt Verbalization),优化了软快取,查询了同一种模式,将它与文本同为口头化,并用光束搜索使口头化变得可靠. 在标准的下意识学习设置中,SALVE可靠地恢复了给老师特质取名的可辨明的提示,而常见的文本优化方法却未能做到. 此外,我们发现有些设置,SALVE从一个数据集中恢复教师的特质,即使潜意识学习失败了,但是修改学生训练以改善上下文分馏可以产生潜意识学习效果. 我们最后显示,SALVE在另外三个场合中检测到潜心学习效果:(1) 潜心学习数据和无关数据的混合物;(2) 教师通过活化向导产生偏差时生成的数据;(3) 通过Logit-Linear选择选择选取的真正偏好数据子集. 总体而言,我们的成果加深了我们对潜心学习的理解,并将SALVE作为主动地检测潜心学习效果的一种方法.

articles.title: Lit3R: Retrieve-Relate-Read for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Scientific Literature
articles.content: We describe tus-nlp's Lit3R (Retrieve-Relate-Read) system for LitTraceQA, a shared task for literature-grounded question answering that requires systems to retrieve relevant papers, identify supporting evidence, and generate answers. Lit3R combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) components without task-specific training. The retriever iteratively combines BM25-based sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based verification, and complements retrieval based on the question with paper-to-paper expansion. The reader first identifies supporting evidence within individual papers and then synthesizes evidence across papers to produce the final answer and evidence trace. On the official test set, our system ranked 4th on the leaderboard. Our code is available at https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa.

articles.title_zh: Lit3R:取回-后传-读取证据-环绕问题解答科学文学.
articles.content_zh: 我们描述了tus-nlp的Lit3R(检索-Relate-Read)系统,即LitTracesQA系统,这是一个基于文献的问答的共同任务,它要求系统检索相关文件,识别辅助证据并生成答案. Lit3R结合了现成的检索,再排位,以及大型语言模型(LLM)组件而无需进行特定任务培训. 检索器迭代地结合了基于BM25的稀疏而密集的检索,交叉编码器重排,和基于LLM的验证,并用纸到纸的扩展来补充基于这个问题的检索. 读者首先在个别论文中找出支持性证据,再将各种论文中的证据综合起来,得出最终答案并追踪证据. 在正式的测试集上,我们的系统在领导板上排名第4. 我们的代码见https://github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa。

articles.title: Disrupted Companionship: A Risk Assessment Framework and Cross-Platform Quantitative Analysis of Psychosocial Responses to AI Companion Disruptions
articles.content: AI companions can provide meaningful relationships, yet these relationships remain vulnerable to platform-initiated changes. We study AI companion disruptions: platform changes that alter or terminate users' ongoing companionship with an AI. We compile 30 disruption events across major platforms, develop a taxonomy of six disruption types, identify three broad reasons for disruption, and propose a risk-assessment framework comprising four dimensions: relational discontinuity, population vulnerability, communication deficit, and transition-support deficit. Using longitudinal Reddit data, we estimate community-level psychosocial responses with a hierarchical Bayesian interrupted time-series model incorporating predictive controls. Across events, disruption onset was associated with immediate increases in anxiety, stress, suicidal expression, and grief activation, with relational discontinuity and transition-support deficit being associated with more adverse immediate responses across several outcomes. Our findings provide a cross-platform characterization of AI companion disruptions, quantitative evidence of their psychosocial impacts, and a prospective framework for assessing their potential risks before implementation.

articles.title_zh: 中断的伴侣关系:风险评估框架和对AI伴侣关系中断心理社会反应的横向定量分析
articles.content_zh: AI同伴可以提供有意义的关系,但这些关系仍然容易受到由平台发起的变化的影响. 我们研究AI的伴奏中断:改变或终止用户与AI的持续伴奏的平台改变. 我们汇编了30起跨主要平台的干扰事件,开发了由6个干扰类型组成的分类系统,确定了干扰的三大原因,并提出了一个由四个方面组成的风险评估框架:关系不连续、人口脆弱性、通信不足和过渡支助赤字。 利用纵向Reddit数据,我们估计社区一级的心理社会反应,一个分级的Bayesian中断时间序列模型包含预测控制。 在各种事件中,中断的发生与焦虑、压力、自杀和悲痛的激活立即增加有关,而关系上的不连续和过渡支助方面的赤字则与若干结果中更为不利的即时反应有关。 我们的调查结果提供了AI伴生中断的跨平台特征、其社会心理影响的定量证据,以及实施前评估其潜在风险的前景框架。

articles.title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech
articles.content: Counterspeech (CS) - direct responses that counter online Hate Speech (HS) using reasoning and alternative viewpoints - has emerged as an alternative to content removal. Current automatic CS generation methods, however, frequently produce generic, ineffective replies that fail to target the implicit stereotypes behind HS. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel scope-conditioned generation framework that explicitly integrates structured stereotype characteristics into Large Language Models prompts. We validate our approach on a novel, human-curated dataset annotated in English, Italian, and Spanish. Extensive evaluations show that stereotype-conditioned prompting substantially outperforms generic baselines across all three languages, obtaining significant gains in factuality, specificity, cogency, and effectiveness for both explicit and implicit implied stereotypes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 破解定型观念:为有效的多种语言反言创造范围化的代言人
articles.content_zh: 反言(Contrespeech)——利用推理和另类观点直接反击网上仇恨言论(HS)——已成为删除内容的替代办法。 然而,目前的自动CS生成方法往往产生通用的、无效的答复,未能针对统一制度背后的隐含定型观念。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了一个具有新颖范围条件的生成框架,明确将结构化的陈规定型特征纳入大语言模型提示。 我们验证了我们对一个用英文、意大利文和西班牙文注解的、经人验证的新数据集的做法。 广泛的评价表明,以定型观念为条件,促使所有三种语文的通用基线都大大超过通用基线,在事实、具体性、一致性和有效性方面都取得了显著的进展,既包括明示的,也包括默示的定型观念。
